cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(NOT DEFINED SDK_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SDK_ROOT to the SDK checkout")
endif()
set(p demo)
set(APPLICATION "${SDK_ROOT}/samples/osal_contract")
set(MODULE_ROOTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../external_module")
set(EXTERNAL_CONTRACT_COMPONENT module_probe)
find_package(RtosSdk REQUIRED CONFIG PATHS "${SDK_ROOT}/share/rtos-sdk-package" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
project(external_contract LANGUAGES NONE)
